info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Status API provides access to the current status of prescriptions managed within the pharmacy system. Users can retrieve detailed information about specific prescriptions, enabling stakeholders such as pharmacists, healthcare providers, and patients to track and manage medication fulfillment effectively. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate prescription status checks into their applications, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency in medication management. This endpoint supports GET requests to ensure timely access to the latest prescription information.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of prescriptions, providing valuable information regarding their processing and fulfillment. It is essential for users to track their medications and ensure timely access.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of prescriptions. This should include the necessary parameters formatted in JSON to effectively query the current statuses of the specified prescriptions.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to prescriptions status. It is expected to be a JSON string.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusResponse_.title: Prescription Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the prescription.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the prescription.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Contains information related to the audit of the prescription.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusResponse_.description: This schema represents the response structure for the GET operation related to the prescription status.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains details regarding the creation and automation of the response.
